name: Lisa Blank
office: Palos Verdes Library District, Member, Board of Trustees

items.text: Lisa Blank is a library user who has worked as a volunteer and a paid staffer. She supports free-library principles, including “access for all” and “the freedom to read.” She proposes offering a broad collection, along with varied programs and expert staff. She says she holds a library science degree.
